stem: Which food pair has a high level of clinical cross-reactivity?
explanation: Cashews and pistachios are the correct answer because they form a tree nut group with high clinical cross-reactivity.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because cashews and pistachios are a well-recognised tree nut pair with high clinical cross-reactivity.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because peanuts and soy do not have high clinical cross-reactivity.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because wheat and other grains are not a classic high cross-reactive food pair.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because peanut allergy and tree nut allergy can coexist, but this is not the specific high cross-reactive pair described here.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because egg and milk are common food allergens, but they are not a high cross-reactive pair.

source.hint: Focus on the nuts that are often grouped together because they belong to the same botanical families.
